summary: M0 model-only verdict: BENIGN @ 0.78. New-device sign-in is the only signal. It occurred from the same IP/ASN/country/city as the established device (LT-6002), with a single MFA approval and no impossible travel, VPN appliance use, repeated MFA prompts, or mailbox events. This is consistent with a legitimate device change rather than confirmed account takeover; raw data lack user/device enrollment confirmation, so confidence is moderate, but no containment-worthy evidence is present.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
